title: WHAT IF YOU COULD SEE EVERYONE'S DEATH TIMER? ⏳💀 #Shorts
description:
What if you could see everyone's exact death timer floating above their head? When Pip saw a stranger's timer hit 5 seconds on a subway platform, he pulled him back just in time! But what happens when he sees his favorite person's clock blinking red? ⏳❤️

Would YOU look in the mirror to see your own timer? Tell us in the comments! 👇
